description: Quarterly earnings highlights deck for an enterprise SaaS company, in the style of a public-company earnings call presentation.
provenance: Modeled on the investor-relations earnings supplements published by mid-cap enterprise software companies each quarter (title slide, headline KPI grid, revenue trend chart, operating highlights, CFO guidance statement, and forward guidance detail). Deliberately exercises a 6-slide mixed-pattern deck: a 4-up KPI dashboard with trend arrows and sublabels, a two-series clustered bar chart across five quarters, dense bullet lists with financial figures, and a long single-sentence statement slide.

document.presentationTitle: Meridian Software Q3 FY2026 Earnings Highlights

content.title: Q3 FY2026 Earnings Highlights
content.subtitle: Quarter ended April 30, 2026 | Reported June 4, 2026 | Investor Relations

content.title: Q3 FY2026 at a glance
content.subtitle: All growth rates year-over-year unless noted; non-GAAP measures reconciled in appendix

content.title: Revenue growth remains durable
content.subtitle: Subscription mix continues to expand as legacy services roll off

content.title: Operating highlights
content.subtitle: Momentum across enterprise, platform, and international
bulletPoints: Closed 47 deals over $1M ACV (vs 31 in Q3 FY25), including our largest-ever contract: a $14.2M three-year platform agreement with a Fortune 100 insurer
Net revenue retention of 118%, up from 114% last quarter, driven by seat expansion and Meridian Analytics attach of 41%
Remaining performance obligations of $1.42B, up 31% YoY; current RPO up 28%
International revenue grew 38% YoY and now represents 29% of total revenue, led by DACH and Japan
Meridian AI Assist reached 2,100 paying customers within three quarters of GA, contributing approximately 2 points of subscription growth
Completed the acquisition of Signalpath ($86M cash) to accelerate the workflow-orchestration roadmap; expected dilution of ~50 bps to FY26 operating margin

content.title: "We delivered our fifth consecutive quarter of accelerating subscription growth while expanding operating margin by over four points — the model is compounding exactly as designed."
content.subtitle: Priya Raghavan, Chief Financial Officer

content.title: Guidance
content.subtitle: As of June 4, 2026; assumes no material change in FX or macro conditions
bulletPoints: Q4 FY2026 revenue: $324M to $328M, representing 21% to 23% YoY growth
Q4 FY2026 non-GAAP operating margin: approximately 19%
FY2026 revenue raised to $1.218B to $1.222B (prior: $1.196B to $1.206B)
FY2026 non-GAAP EPS raised to $2.41 to $2.45 (prior: $2.28 to $2.36)
FY2026 free cash flow margin: approximately 22%, inclusive of Signalpath integration costs
Share count: approximately 128M fully diluted weighted-average shares for Q4
prose: Guidance reflects continued elongation of enterprise sales cycles in EMEA, offset by stronger-than-expected AI Assist attach rates in North America.
